activity_statements.statement: operates 370+ quick-service burger restaurants across California, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Texas, Oregon, Colorado, Washington, and Tennessee with a menu unchanged since 1948
operates 8 owned distribution centers (CA, TX, NV, AZ, CO, UT, OR) that receive, warehouse, and deliver all product to restaurants — fully vertically integrated supply chain
prepares all food fresh and made-to-order in each restaurant with no heat lamps or freezers, maintaining cold chain integrity from distribution centers
maintains food safety and quality assurance programs (FSMA-compliant) across all supply chain functions including produce QA, cold chain management, and supplier auditing
remains privately owned and operated under family ownership with no franchise model and no external shareholders

name_reality_gap: The 'Restaurants & Food Service' label is accurate but hides that In-N-Out Burger is also a vertically integrated food logistics company operating 8 regional distribution centers and a rigorous supplier quality program — more supply chain infrastructure than most fast-food brands maintain.
extraction_notes: in-n-out.com direct pages mostly returned 404; profile built from supply chain transparency page, a job posting on the careers site, and a third-party food safety job listing. These sources provided good operational detail on the vertically-integrated supply chain model.
